summary: Caster/pet MP implant build: maximizes the nano schools that keep pets and buffs high (Matter Creation + Time&Space for the attack pet, Bio Met for the heal pet, Psycho Mod + Sensory Impr to cast buffs sooner, Matter Met), backed by Nano Pool, Treatment and Nano C. Init, with evades + Body Dev for survivability. Every cluster is placed only in a slot/grade its cluster list actually allows (cross-checked against implants.json).
_gradeMeaning: shiny = biggest bonus, bright = ~60%, faded = ~40%. A skill placed in two implants (e.g. one bright + one faded) stacks. Because each cluster has exactly one shiny/bright/faded home, some skills can only be obtained at a lower grade once their shiny home slot is used for something else.
_qualityNote: QL values are the typical top-tier target for regular implants (~200). Higher QLs exist via twinking/laddering and Jobe/refined clusters; at true endgame several slots are usually replaced by symbiants. QLs here are guidance, not sourced exact values.

_coverageSummary.TimeAndSpace: Eye faded only (deprioritized in favour of Matter Creation)
_coverageSummary.Evades: Evade-ClsC (Feet shiny + Legs bright), Dodge-Rng (Legs shiny + Feet bright), Duck-Exp (Feet faded)

ladder: Max Treatment every level (needed to equip each QL of implant: Treatment req ~ QL*4.7+11; ability req ~ QL*2+4). To reach top QL, ladder up: equip the survivability/Treatment implants first, stack Treatment- and ability-buffs (Trader wrangles, First-Aid/BioMet stims, Expertise/Essence, Behemoth/Sadist etc.), then swap in the high-QL caster implants one QL step at a time. Advies/Traders have the cheapest Treatment for over-equipping. Use Auno Implant Designer / TinkerPlants / AOLadderer to solve the exact ladder for your character's skills.
_deviations: The Neoseeker MP FAQ only specifies the 6 'important' caster slots (Head, Eye, Ear, Chest, Waist, Right Hand). The other 7 slots (Right/Left Arm, Right/Left Wrist, Legs, Left Hand, Feet) are filled here from the best MP-relevant clusters each slot/grade allows, per implants.json.
Chose Matter Creation over Time & Space where the guide said 'MC/TS' (Head shiny + RightHand bright both MC), so TS is only picked up as Eye faded. A TS-focused MP would flip these.
Chest shiny set to Body Dev. for HP (guide only named Chest bright=BM, faded=SI). Nano Pool shiny also lives in Chest; swap if nano is valued over HP.
Right Wrist and Left Wrist contain no caster/nano clusters at any grade in the mapping, so they are left as fillers.
_unverified: Exact QLs: the located guide (Neoseeker MP FAQ) is a pre-level-100 setup; the ~QL200 'top-of-the-line' target here is inference, not a sourced number.

A full endgame MP twink implant sheet (LordDredd/Auno saved builds) could not be retrieved (403/paywalled), so the 7 non-core slots are my mapping-consistent recommendation rather than a copied guide layout.
At endgame MPs commonly replace several implant slots with symbiants; that tradeoff is noted qualitatively, not modelled here.
